title: Mixed Event — Musical Twilight Parade — Episode3 Nice To Meet You?! Wonderhoy!

meta.Episode: Episode3 — Nice To Meet You?! Wonderhoy!
meta.Event Outline: Shiho has been scouted by a band that's ready to make its big debut, giving her a lot to think about. Then, Saki invites her on a visit to Phoenix Wonderland. Meanwhile, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS make their own preparations, eager to host them!

rows.Line: Weekend
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That was awesome, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Your singing sounds more tra-la-la-la now☆
And it even feels sparkly too♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I think I know a great way to make you sparkle even more☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Check. This. Out...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ta-da☆ You just need a big smile!
Your voice will feel happier♪
And you'll sparkle even more☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It'll give everyone watching a big smiley face too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really... Okay.
I'll try to keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah☆ We can do it together too...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nene!
Tsukasa's asking everyone to gather for a rehearsal♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah, okay...! I'll be right there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
"Come on, everyone!!
Let us sing and dance!!
All for this glorious day!!!!"
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So loud...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa sounds super psyched today!
Did something good happen to him?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Apparently, his sister and some of her friends will be visiting Phoenix Wonderland today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So he's all fired up and even said,
"I'm going to put on the greatest show ever!"

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Tsukasa sometimes takes time off to look after his sister when she's sick and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He must really love her a lot!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, I guess everyone has one good quality about them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hahahaha!
I'm on the roll of all rolls today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When Saki and her friends watch us perform, all their anxieties will melt away and refresh their spirits for band practice!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wonderhoy☆
We're right behind you, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I don't particularly care...
It's not like I don't ever try my hardest...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: True. So let's give it our all and bring smile to everyone's faces today like we always do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe! You're all really raring to go☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna be in lots and lots more shows with everyone too♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Rin! You're at the stage today!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, Rin hasn't been coming to the stage very often, huh? Where were you all this time?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I've been all over the place, performing shows and giving everyone big smiley faces☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa, that sounds like fun!
I want to perform in different places too,
and make people smile everywhere I go...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then let's go together next time☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Together, we can make much, much, MUCH happier shows than ever before♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, you've got yourself a deal!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmph! We can't lose the spotlight to them!
Let's do one more rehearsal just to be sure!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just don't overdo it before the actual show.
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa...! It's really PXL!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's been so long since we last came here together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow... I was expecting a lot to have changed, but it's almost all the same.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Doesn't this bring back memories?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, is Tsukasa waiting for us somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! He said he wants to introduce us to the rest of his troupe today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's nice. I'm looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! I wonder what they're like♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, there he is!
Tsukasaaa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hello, Saki, and everyone from Leo/need!
Welcome to my Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, Phoenix Wonderland isn't yours...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahem! Anyway...!
Allow me to introduce you to my troupe,
the amazing cast of Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And everyone, this is our special guest...!
The one I invited here today. My sister...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!! It's Saki!
Wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu! I didn't know you were performing in the same shows as my brother!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Otori...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I knew she performed in PXL shows, but I had no idea she was in the same troupe as Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait... Isn't she in your class, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What's that...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a small world after all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After getting so worked up about his grand introduction too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh! That girl... She was the one singing at the park the other day... She's also in Tsukasa's troupe...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Maybe I can ask her for some tips about becoming a better singer...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: E-Excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Urgh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Why are you hiding behind me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No reason...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm sorry about this.
Nene's a little shy around strangers.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't worry, she'll be able to converse normally once she gets to know you better. Please give her some time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, since we're all here,
let's all visit some attractions together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, it's not every day I get to meet my classmates at Phoenix Wonderland like this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Our show starts in the evening anyway.
We have time, right?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's get to know each other by having lots of fun together! That's what being wonderhoy is all about☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
We already finished rehearsing this morning.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's true. Then...
Why don't we show all of you around the park?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes, please! I'd love to get to know everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime better too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too!
What about you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do you say, Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine by me. I'm here for you today anyway, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yaaay! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Follow us, then! Your epic adventure around Phoenix Wonderland is about to begin☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Awesome♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Aww, Nene!
What's with the long face?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<This is a great chance to make new friends, isn't it?
Bring your smiley face and have some fun☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What...?! Rin?!
You'll startle people if they see you like this.
You need to be a little more discreet.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<But, but, but...
I was just so worried about you, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I appreciate that. I really do... But I just can't help but feel nervous around people I've never met before...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hmmm... Nervous, you say...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I know☆ I can be the small voice in your ear that eggs you on to smile and have fun with everyone♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You don't have to. Imagine what would happen if someone saw you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Don't worry! I'll be super stealthy!
Sneaky sneak☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's not really sneaky at all...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But thank you... I won't be able to open up to them right away, but I'll try to make it happen.
